records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Assessment of Local Risks supporting the London Safety Plan 2017. The page states that ward-level data for the 2017 AoLR is published in XLS and CSV formats and underpins the LFB postcode look-up tool. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward identity E05009390 to that unused official risk-assessment ward-data source; the Campden row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
